clips.title: The story
paras: Carendin Halgar sends Horde warlocks across the Great Sea to seek Strahad Farsan. Above Ratchet, a human sorcerer offers a path beyond basic shadowcraft toward the difficult art of summoning a felhunter.

Carendin Halgar, a Forsaken warlock trainer in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, knows when an initiate has outgrown basic instruction. He sends his pupils beyond Lordaeron's ruins to find Strahad Farsan. Halgar warns that Strahad is a living human, but no weakling, and says not to treat him as an enemy. For warlocks, the pursuit of demonic mastery often crosses racial and factional lines.

Strahad works from the bluffs above Ratchet, the goblin port in the Barrens. Near a stone watchtower, he looks down on the sailors, mercenaries, and merchants below, whose blissful ignorance of the Twisting Nether amuses him. Horde warlocks who reach him may bring distrust and simmering hatred in their eyes. Strahad accepts that raw malice as fuel to shape into dark authority.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have taught you skills in the past, but the time has come for another to teach you. He is in Ratchet, and his name is Strahad. He is human, but do not let that fool you into thinking he is weak, nor is he your enemy... At least for now. He is powerful and should be respected. He can teach you about greater summonings, summonings I feel you are prepared for. Go to him now.
You can find him in Ratchet... Above the port town next to the tower there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A busy day in Ratchet, isn't it? How I enjoy watching the toil of a port city. So much mystery, so much adventure... So much ignorance.
Is that hatred I see in your eyes, friend? Good, we will put that to good use.
